query:
SELECT
                        id,
                        layer_id,
                        marker_name,
                        latitude,
                        longitude,
                        detail,
                        update_at
                    FROM marker_info_model
                    WHERE user_id = $1
                        AND (
                        marker_name LIKE $2 ESCAPE '\'
                        OR detail LIKE $2 ESCAPE '\'
                    )
                        AND (
                        marker_name LIKE $3 ESCAPE '\'
                        OR detail LIKE $3 ESCAPE '\'
                    )
